title: China conducts combat readiness patrols around disputed shoal in South China Sea
paragraphs: China conducts combat readiness patrols around disputed shoal in South China Sea
China said that the patrols were a "necessary countermeasure in response to the Philippines' rights-violation and provocative acts".

BEIJING: China's military said on Friday (Oct 30) its naval and air forces conducted combat readiness patrols around Scarborough Shoal, which has long been a flashpoint in tensions between Beijing and Manila in the South China Sea.
